sources.title: Paronella Park
sources.excerpt: Paronella Park is located at Mena Creek, Queensland, Australia, 120 kilometres (75 mi) south of Cairns. Designed from the first as an entertainment attraction in a park-like setting, it was modeled on Spanish and European architecture and featured outdoor spaces for activities like swimming, playing tennis, strolling and picnicking. It fell derelict for a few decades but has been refurbished into a heritage-listed tourist attraction.
